msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed your theory and pool sessions, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option to finish your certification. Just bring your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor; the e-learning certificate alone may not replace that paperwork.

You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. It’s a separate one-day activity, with pool practice and one ocean dive.

The refresher is for certified divers who haven’t dived in over 2 years. It doesn’t count toward the Open Water certification, so please check with your PADI center whether it’s appropriate before your referral dives. The referral course also requires at least *18 hours before flying* after diving.

The referral course requires the PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Of course! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, so pick-up is direct. Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*; depending on the hotel, pick-up may be at a nearby dock or meeting point.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Accommodation isn’t included in the diving plans, so you’ll book directly with the hotel. Do you have a particular hotel in mind?

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
That sounds like a lovely plan! We operate every day except December 25 and January 1, weather permitting, so Easter Sunday is normally an operating day. The booking calendar will let you choose your dates and the number of people.

Just to clarify, the refresher isn’t $50. Since you’ll be staying on the islands, it’s *$134 USD per person online* and is booked as the *Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)*. It includes pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor; lunch isn’t included. You can book and pay online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

A refresher and a certified diver can go together on the same outing.

For your *2-day Open Water Referral Course*, please contact our team to arrange it, as I don’t have a booking link for that course here. Would you like me to connect you with an advisor for the referral course?
